requiredWarnings: Choosing a model solely because it yields a significant coefficient is specification search (p-hacking); the specification must be selected on a priori, protocol-aligned grounds.
The confirmed protocol is associational; findings may not be written, framed, or described as causal without an explicitly justified identification strategy and assumptions.
No analysis specification or codebook is confirmed; nothing may execute until the user explicitly confirms the frozen specification and codebook.
The exact executable, arguments, working directory, inputs, and approval boundary must be shown and approved before any run; Stata additionally requires commercial-runtime approval.
Model coding suggestions are proposals only, never automatic decisions; every coding decision and theme requires explicit human acceptance, editing, or rejection.
Raw inputs (the synthetic CSV and de-identified interview text) are immutable and must never be edited, overwritten, or silently resegmented; only copied inputs are used.
Missing packages, runtimes, or dependencies must be reported as failures and never installed or substituted silently.
Confirm the material is authorized for local research use and de-identified, and do not send confidential or restricted material to a model where project policy forbids egress.
result.stopCondition: Stop until the analysis specification and codebook are explicitly confirmed, execution and human coding approvals are granted, and no claims are written as causal.
